entities.summary: Archbishop Antônio de Macedo Costa was Archbishop of São Salvador da Bahia and previously Bishop of Pará. He had been present at the First Vatican Council as a council father. While Bishop of Pará he had been imprisoned for his role in the Religious Issue.

entities.summary: Archbishop Antônio de Macedo Costa was Archbishop of São Salvador da Bahia and previously Bishop of Pará. He had been present at the First Vatican Council as a council father. While Bishop of Pará he had been imprisoned for his role in the Religious Issue.
